subject.title: feat(agents): configured agent env reaches spawned subprocesses

question: Should OpenClaw accept broad literal `agents.list[].env` for CLI, exec, ACP/ACPX, and stdio MCP child processes, or prefer the narrower exec-only SecretRef direction in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96309?
rationale: The patch changes a public operator config and credential-handling boundary across several runtime owners; automation can verify plumbing but cannot choose the permanent product/security contract.

options.title: Choose the canonical env contract first
options.body: Resolve broad literal per-agent env versus narrower SecretRef/exec-only env, then merge only the implementation that matches that decision.

options.title: Accept this broad contract
options.body: Treat this PR as the canonical sanitized child-process env surface once exact-head checks are refreshed and green.

options.title: Pause behind the exec-only alternative
options.body: Keep this PR open or close it later only if the exec-only SecretRef path becomes the accepted and merged implementation.

recommendation.title: Choose the canonical env contract first
recommendation.body: Resolve broad literal per-agent env versus narrower SecretRef/exec-only env, then merge only the implementation that matches that decision.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the clearest visible history across the config/runtime boundary and was named in the PR discussion as prior reviewer guidance for the predecessor attempt.
